title: Independent customer report
brief: Assemble independent customer summaries into an explainable report.
instructions: Return every customer. Count paid UTC 2024 orders, their transaction revenue, and refunded return amounts on those orders. Label customers paid or no_paid. Fill missing counts and amounts with zero.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes customer_id,customer_name from customers without solving independent customer report.

hints.text: Named, independently grouped summaries prevent fan-out.
Reuse paid orders for counts, item revenue, and refunded returns, then left join each to customers.
The orderless customer remains; a rejected return is not a refund.
